name: Shenzhen CECport Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen CECport Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of electronic components in China and internationally. The company distributes CPUs, GPUs, MCUs, memory, RF and wireless connectivity products, discrete devices, sensors, and programmable logic under various brand names for consumer electronics, communication systems, industrial electronics, computing, automotive, and other related applications.
